sourceCopy.name: Business Letter Generator
sourceCopy.title: Business Letter Generator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Create a free formal business letter with a clear layout. Edit, preview, copy, download, or print on A4 or Letter paper.
sourceCopy.intro: Build a straightforward business letter with sender and recipient addresses, date, subject, greeting, message, closing, and signature. Preview and print it in your browser.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: What goes in a formal business letter?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: A typical letter includes the sender and recipient addresses, date, optional subject, greeting, body, closing, and signature. Adapt the format and wording to your situation.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Are my letter details uploaded or saved?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. Your draft stays in this browser tab. It is not automatically saved or uploaded. Copy, download, or print it when you choose.

fields.sender: Your name and address (one line per item)
fields.recipient: Recipient name and address (one line per item)
fields.subject: Subject (optional)
fields.accuracyNote: A general correspondence template. You write and review the content; it does not provide legal advice or automatically draft a letter.
fields.privacyNote: Draft details stay in this tab unless you copy, download, or print them. Nothing is sent to a server.

messages.invalid: Check the required fields, date, and supported length.
messages.copyUnavailable: Clipboard access is unavailable; select the preview text instead.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I choose A4 or US Letter paper?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. Select A4 or US Letter before updating the preview. Print uses the selected size; your browser print dialog may also offer its own settings.

additionalFaqs.question: Can this tool write a legal or job application letter for me?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It is a general business correspondence layout, not legal advice, a statutory form, or a cover-letter builder. You provide and review all wording.
